text:
Priya: Free pickup  adjustable standing desk converter (Varidesk-style) + dual monitor arm (VESA)  moving out of SF office this Friday. Both in good condition, converter has mild surface marks. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Ben: Ooh interested. What are the max monitor sizes for the arm?
Priya: Arm supports up to 27\" per arm, 8kg each, gas spring is still strong. Converter fits up to 36\" desk width.
Sam: Any idea on how heavy the converter is? I might need help loading into my hatchback.
Priya: Converter is ~25lbs assembled. Can be separated into two pieces for carry.
office-manager-bot: Reminder: please coordinate pickups with reception. Building security requires a visitor list for weekend access.
Ben: I can pick up Sat morning. Will need exact floor/room to avoid waiting.
Priya: I'll leave them in Team Beta storage (2nd floor, next to lockers). Keycode for the room: TL-Open-2026 (reception will buzz you).
Sam: If Ben can't make it, I'm also happy to swing by Sun. Also have an extra set of cable ties if someone needs them. :grin:
Ben: DM'd Priya to confirm. Please mark items with a sticky that says \"HOLD - BEN\" so others don't snag them.
Priya: Marked and put a note on the shelf. If plans change, Ben please update this thread.
Ben: Confirmed pickup Sat 10:30am. Thanks Priya!
Priya: No prob. If anyone wants the mounting screws, I left a small bag labeled \"screws + washers\" on top of the converter.
Sam: Appreciate you giving these away instead of hauling to the dump. I might ask for cable ties later.
office-manager-bot: FYI donation corner is available on Monday if you want to drop anything there instead.
Priya: Will update if pickup falls through. Otherwise they're gone. :dancers:
